title: Florida Springs & Manatee Kayak or Paddleboard Adventure
paragraphs: Florida Springs Adventure is a small-group, hosted getaway to Florida's spring-fed waterways. Additionally, guests can hope to see river otters, fish, maybe even monkeys. A full-day paddle at Silver Springs with a packed lunch on the water. Morning snorkel, check-out, and return to TPA.

Silver Springs wildlife safari paddle: crystal-clear water, birds, fish, and the monkeys. Manatee country: paddle in waterways known for consistent manatee activity. Weeki Wachee serenity paddle: peaceful, scenic, and unbelievably spring-fed water. Crystal River springs exploration: paddle to check out multiple springs and clear-water pockets.

Snorkel tour included: experience Crystal River from below the surface, too. Guided paddling days at Crystal River, Silver Springs, and Weeki Wachee (route/timing may adjust for conditions). facts.description: Florida Springs Adventure is a small-group, fully hosted getaway to Florida's most iconic spring-fed waterways. Over four days we'll paddle Silver Springs, Weeki Wachee, and Crystal River, with a snorkel tour included in Crystal River. Expect crystal-clear water, wildlife, and that classic “old Florida” scenery-plus a smooth, stress-free experience because we handle the transportation, gear, and launch logistics so you can just show up and enjoy. Wildlife note: Wildlife is wild, so sightings can't be guaranteed-but Crystal River and these spring systems are known for consistent manatee activity, and it would be very unusual not to spot them during our time on the water. Additionally, we can hope to see river otters, amazing fish, maybe even monkeys! This trip is capped at 12 guests and includes private-room lodging at Crystal River Plantation Resort.
